determinism_contract: identical config bytes plus identical fixture-input bytes must yield byte-identical canonical rows; any nondeterminism the harness observes is a fixture defect, not an implementation defect

env_sanitization.env_digest_recipe: SHA-256 over JCS of the single object {name: value} of the COMPLETE presented (m-1-sanitized) child env; construction-time duplicate names rejected; a non-UTF-8 value is a reachable pre-spawn typed reject; the input is NEVER the pre-sanitization parent environment

limits_table.note: xit-dur-5 and xit-op-1 additionally require the build-tagged TEST-ONLY reduced limits table (m-10 producer-delta §4): under the production table resume_frame_overflow is statically unreachable by the compile-time assertion.

policy.policy_digest_source: the ratified policy bytes verified at load against policy_digest (m-8 §5.3)

provider_lane.pinning: exactly one lane pinned per run from the immutable lane catalog; method authority is the lane catalog fact

purpose: The frozen run configuration both the baseline and every governed fixture run load. Named by baseline_config_digest in STEP-3-EXIT-FIXTURES.json.
